claims.summary: La ilustración fonética del ruso documenta que la vocal /e/ se asocia con palatalización y que la realización de vocales depende del acento y del contexto consonántico.

sections: Illustrations of the IPA: consonant and vowel inventories and transcription of the Russian illustration, pp. 222–226; includes [a], voiced alveolar plosive /d/ and its palatalized counterpart, and context-conditioned realizations of Cyrillic е.
